title.en: Caring team alongside occasional service complaints

text.en: Several pet owners praise the veterinary team for their compassion, patience, and dedicated holistic care. Clients appreciate vets who listen closely during consultations and reassure anxious animals. However, some reviewers note inconsistent customer service, reporting an unfriendly encounter with shop staff and unhelpful guidance during a serious pet illness.

title.en: Thorough explanations and helpful phone support

text.en: Reviewers highlight open discussions with veterinary staff when planning complex surgeries and long-term treatments. Pet owners appreciate clear advice before procedures and note that clinic coordinators take time to answer questions calmly. Clients describe feeling well supported when coordinating appointments and discussing care options.

title.en: Concerns over fees and invoice estimates

text.en: While one client appreciated transparent up-front pricing for regular care, multiple reviewers express frustration with high veterinary costs. Pet owners report discrepancies between initial procedure estimates and final invoices, including unexpected charges for medications and steep fees during emergency treatments.

q.en: Does The Natural Vet offer holistic treatments alongside conventional care?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention attending the clinic specifically for holistic medicine and tailored individual pet care.

q.en: How are surgical estimates handled at the clinic?

a.en: While some owners report upfront cost discussions, others advise confirming detailed estimates in advance to avoid unexpected surgical fees.

q.en: Can owners purchase pet food and supplies on site?

a.en: Yes, the practice operates an adjoining pet shop providing animal nutrition, supplies, and natural treats.

q.en: How quickly can consultations be booked?

a.en: Clients note that routine and procedure appointments can generally be scheduled promptly with the reception team.
